features.title: Generous space for family comfort
features.text: Wide seating easily accommodates three, making it perfect for family lounging, hosting guests, or stretching out solo.

features.title: Pocket-spring bounce that supports all
features.text: Each seat retains its lift and buoyancy, so comfort is shared equally across the sofa, no matter where you sit.

features.title: Broad armrests for relaxed sitting
features.text: Spacious arms provide support while lounging, turning every seat into a spot where you can lean, stretch, or balance a tray.

features.title: Elegant stitching for a refined touch
features.text: Craftsmanship shows in the neat, tailored stitch lines, elevating your living room with subtle style.

features.title: Blue finish that enlivens the room
features.text: The bold blue fabric creates a fresh focal point, energizing your interiors while blending easily with contemporary furniture.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
